turns.text: What do you usually do in the morning?
I... I get up... then I... I wash my face... and I... I eat... breakfast... sometimes coffee...
How long does it take you to get ready?
It... it take... about... half hour... maybe more... if... if I... sleep late...
Do you have any routine after work?
After... after work... I go... home... I watch TV... or I... I read... book... sometimes... I walk...
What do you do on weekends?
Weekend... I... I sleep late... I go... market... buy food... and... I see friends... maybe...
How would you describe the area where you live?
My... my area... it is... small... it has... many trees... and... some houses...
Is the environment clean?
Clean... sometimes... there is... trash... on street... but... people... clean it...
What kind of transport do you use?
I... I use... motorbike... also bus... sometimes... walk...
Do you think the area will change in future?
Maybe... more... buildings... more people... maybe more... noise...
Do you enjoy reading?
Yes... I... I like... reading... but... not many... time...
What kind of books do you read?
I read... story... novel... also... news...
How often do you read?
I read... maybe... twice... a week... sometimes... more...
Where do you usually read?
I read... at home... on couch... sometimes... at park...
Do you like cooking at home?
Um... I... like... cooking... I think... I cook... sometimes... but... sometimes I... no, I... not... good...
What kind of food do you prefer to make?
I... make... rice... and... vegetables... maybe... chicken... but... I... repeat... rice...
Is there any dish you find difficult?
Difficult... soup... because... water... and... salt... I... not... know...
Do you enjoy trying new recipes?
New... recipes... I try... sometimes... but... I... stop... because... hard...
Do you use technology for leisure?
Yes... I... use... phone... for... games... and... video...
What kind of games do you like?
I... like... puzzle... game... and... racing... game... but... I... play... short...
How often do you watch videos online?
Often... I... watch... video... on... phone... maybe... many... times... a day...
Do you think technology changes how people relax?
Yes... it... change... relax... because... people... use... phone... not... TV...
How do you choose a gift for someone?
I... think... about... person... and... I... choose... something... simple... like... tea... or... book...
Do you prefer giving something useful or something decorative?
Useful... because... they... need... it... I... give... mug... or... pen...
What kind of gifts are popular in your country?
Popular... are... food... sweets... and... small... items... like... key... chain...
Is there a special occasion when you give gifts?
Yes... birthday... and... holiday... I... give... gift... then...
What time do you usually get up?
Umm... I, I get up at... six o’clock, I think... maybe six thirty? I need to check.
Can you tell me about your morning routine?
I... I wash face, then I brush my teeth, and I... I have coffee. Sometimes I eat bread.
Do you exercise in the morning?
No, I... I not exercise. I maybe walk a little.
How do you travel to work or school?
I take bus. The bus is... it is crowded but okay.
How would you describe the environment in your neighbourhood?
It is... it is good? There are trees, but also many cars, very noisy.
What kind of green spaces are there?
There is a park, small park, with... with some benches and... kids play.
Do you think the area is clean?
Sometimes clean, sometimes not. There is trash on streets.
What would you like to change?
I want more trees, less traffic, more... more clean.
Do you enjoy reading books?
Yes, I... I like reading, but I not read a lot.
What kind of books do you prefer?
I like story books, like romance, also some... history books.
How often do you read?
Maybe two times a week, sometimes less.
Where do you usually read?
At home, on my bed, sometimes at coffee shop.
Do you use e‑books or paper books?
I use paper more, e‑books... I not like them much.
What kind of food do you like to eat?
I... I like... uh, I like pho, but I also… I like rice… sometimes… I need the question again?
Can you tell me about your favourite dish?
My favourite dish is bun… bun bo… it’s a beef noodle, I think… very tasty… I like it a lot.
Do you often cook at home?
I… I cook sometimes… I try to cook rice, but I… I forget the steps.
What do you think about trying new foods?
I think it is… it is interesting, but sometimes… I am not sure…
How do you usually spend your free time?
I… I watch… I watch TV… and also I use phone… I need the question again?
Do you use any technology for leisure?
Yes, I use smartphone… I play game… I also watch video on YouTube… sometimes I watch…
What kind of games do you prefer?
I like… I like simple game… like puzzle… but I not good at… complex game.
Do you think technology changes the way people relax?
Yes, I think… it changes… people stay at home more… using phone…
What kind of gifts do you like to give?
I… I like give… I give small thing… like a book, but I not sure… I need the question again?
Can you describe a gift you gave recently?
I gave my friend a… a shirt… it was blue… I think she liked it…
How do you choose a gift for someone?
I think about… what they like… I ask my friend… but sometimes I not know.
Do you prefer to buy gifts or make them yourself?
I prefer buy… because I not good at make… I think it is easier…
What do you usually do in the morning?
I... I wake up early, I think, at six o’clock, then I brush my teeth and... and I have a coffee. I sometimes also read the news on my phone.
Do you have a regular breakfast?
Yes, I usually eat bread with jam, or sometimes rice porridge. I like rice porridge, it is warm.
How do you get to work or school?
I take the bus. The bus is... is usually late, but I... I try to leave home early.
What do you do in the evening?
In the evening I come home, I cook dinner, I watch TV, and then I study or... I read a book before sleep.
How would you describe the environment in your neighbourhood?
My neighbourhood is... it is quiet, but there are many trees. The air is fresh, sometimes a bit dusty because of traffic.
Are there many parks nearby?
Yes, there is a big park near my house. I go there to walk, to walk with my family. It is nice.
Do you think the local government does enough to keep the area clean?
I think they try, but... but sometimes they forget to clean the streets. The garbage bins are often full.
What changes would you like to see?
I would like more recycling bins, and more trees planted. More trees would make the air better.
Do you enjoy reading books?
Yes, I like reading. I read sometimes in the evening, after dinner.
What kind of books do you prefer?
I like novels, especially romance and mystery. I also read some history books.
How often do you read?
I try to read at least one chapter each day, but sometimes I am busy and I read only on weekends.
Where do you usually read?
I read at home, on my sofa, sometimes in the park if the weather is good.
Do you think reading is important?
Yes, reading helps me relax and also improves my English, I think.
Do you like cooking at home?
Yes, I… I like cooking at home because it is... it is cheaper and I can control the taste.
What kind of food do you usually prepare?
I usually prepare Vietnamese food, like pho and... and spring rolls. I also sometimes try rice... rice with fish.
Do you prefer eating out or at home?
I prefer eating at home because I can... I can choose the ingredients and it is more comfortable.
Is there any dish you would like to learn?
I would like to learn to make... make sushi, because it looks nice and healthy.
Do you use technology for leisure?
Yes, I use my phone for... for watching videos and playing games.
What kind of games do you enjoy?
I enjoy simple games, like puzzle games and... and racing games.
Do you think technology changes how people relax?
I think it does, because people... people spend more time on screens instead of... instead of reading books.
Do you have a favourite app?
My favourite app is... is a music streaming app, because I like listening music.
Do you like giving gifts?
Yes, I like giving gifts because it is... it is nice to make people happy.
What kind of gifts do you usually buy?
I usually buy small gifts, like books or... or some souvenirs.
How do you choose a gift?
I think about the person, their... their interest and try to find something useful.
Do you ever make gifts yourself?
Sometimes I make simple gifts, like... like handmade cards.
What time do you usually get up?
I... I usually get up at six o'clock in the morning, but sometimes I... I stay up late last night and then I wake up later.
What do you do after you get up?
After I get up, I brush my teeth, I take a shower and then I have a breakfast, usually coffee and toast.
Do you have a regular routine on weekends?
On weekend I try to have same routine, but I also go market and I meet my friends for coffee.
How do you feel about your daily schedule?
I think it is quite good because it helps me to be organized, but sometimes it make me feel tired.
How would you describe the area where you live?
I live in a small district near the river, there are many trees and a park, but also a lot of traffic noise.
What do you like most about it?
I like the park most because I can walk there and see the river, it is very peaceful and fresh.
Are there any problems in your neighbourhood?
Yes, sometimes the garbage not taken away on time, and the street lights are broken, which make it unsafe at night.
How do you think the environment could be improved?
I think the council should plant more trees, clean the river and fix the lights, also they could organise community clean-ups.
Do you enjoy reading?
Yes, I enjoy reading, especially novels, because they take me to another world.
What kind of books do you prefer?
I prefer fiction, especially mystery and romance, but sometimes I read history books for study.
How often do you read?
I try to read every day, maybe half an hour before I go to sleep, but sometimes I forget.
Do you think reading is important?
I think reading is very important because it improve my vocabulary and also help me to understand other cultures.
What kind of food do you like to eat?
I like, uh, spicy food, especially pho and some fried rice, because it taste good.
Do you enjoy cooking at home?
Sometimes I try, but I not very good, I often burn the oil.
What is your favorite restaurant?
My favourite is a small place near my house, they sell grilled chicken, it is very delicious but the service is a little slow.
Would you like to try food from other countries?
Yes, I want to try Italian pasta, although I think the taste will be very different from Vietnamese food.
How often do you use technology for leisure?
I use my phone almost everyday, I watch videos and sometimes I play game.
What kind of games do you prefer?
I like puzzle games, because they make me think, but sometimes they are too hard for me.
Do you think technology has changed the way people relax?
Yes, before people read books, now they watch series on tablet, it make them more comfortable.
Is there any technology you avoid?
I try not to use social media too much, because it can be waste of time, but I still check it sometimes.
How do you choose a gift for someone?
I think about what they like, for example if they love coffee I will buy a coffee mug, but I sometimes forget the details.
What was the best gift you ever gave?
The best gift I gave was a handmade photo album for my sister, she was very happy because it was personal.
Do you prefer to buy gifts or make them yourself?
I prefer to make them, because it shows more effort, but I not good at crafts, so I often buy.
How important is the price of a gift?
Price is not so important, I think the thought behind it is more important, however sometimes I worry about being too cheap.
Will you give gifts during festivals?
Yes, during Tet I always give red envelopes, because it is tradition and people expect it.
What time do you usually wake up?

I usually wake up at seven o'clock because I have a habit of early rising to enjoy the morning air. It is a very good way to start the day with energy, although sometimes I am lazy and sleep until eight.
Do you have a specific routine for breakfast?

Yes, I like to eat a heavy breakfast. I usually have fried eggs with a baguette and some coffee. I think that taking the first meal is important to give me the strength to work, so I never skip it even if I am in a rush.
How do you usually spend your evenings?

In the evening, I like to relax at home. I might watch some television or read a book. Sometimes, if my friends are free, we go out to eat dinner together. I find that socializing helps me reduce the stress from my work day.
Is your daily routine different on weekends?

Yes, it is quite different. On weekends, I sleep in until nine or ten o'clock. I also like to do some housework, like cleaning the room or washing clothes, which I don't have time for during the week. It feels more comfortable to have a slower pace.
Is there a park near where you live?

Yes, there is a large park about ten minutes' walk from my apartment. It is a very popular place for local residents to go for a walk or exercise. The environment there is quite fresh and peaceful compared to the noisy streets outside.
Do you often visit that park?

I try to go there at least twice a week, usually on Sunday mornings. I like the feeling of breathing in the fresh air and seeing the greenery. However, sometimes the park is very crowded with people doing aerobics, so I prefer to go there earlier in the morning.
What kinds of plants or animals can you see there?

There are many types of trees and flowers, but I am not very good at naming them. I often see squirrels running around and different kinds of birds singing in the trees. I think the biodiversity there is quite good for an urban area, which makes it a nice place to relax.
Has the condition of the park changed recently?

Yes, I noticed that the city council has repaired the pathways and added more benches. They also planted more flowers along the walkways. I think these improvements make the park more attractive, but I hope they will install more trash bins to keep the area clean.
Do you enjoy reading books?
Yes, I enjoy reading books because it makes me relax and also it helps me to broaden my mind.
What kind of books do you prefer?
I prefer novels, especially the ones that are full of adventure and romance, although sometimes I read some scientific magazines.
How often do you read?
I try to read at least one hour each evening, sometimes more on the weekend when I have more free time.
Do you think reading is important for young people?
Absolutely, I think it is very important because it can improve their vocabulary and also give them a better understanding of the world.
What type of food do you like the most?
I like Vietnamese street food the most, especially pho and banh mi, they are very tasty and aromatic.
Do you often cook at home?
I sometimes cook at home, but I prefer to eat out because the flavors are more authentic and I don't have much time.
Is there a dish you dislike?
I am not a big fan of very spicy dishes, they make my stomach feel uneasy.
How has your taste in food changed over the years?
When I was younger, I liked simple meals, but now I enjoy trying new cuisines and more complex flavors.
Do you like spending time with technology in your free time?
Yes, I really do. I think it is a good way to relax after a long day. For example, I often watch online movies or play some video games because they help me escape from reality for a while.
How has technology changed the way you relax?

Well, in the past, my family used to read books or just sit in the garden. But now, we are more connected to digital things. I find it convenient to control everything with my phone, even the lights in my house, which makes life easier but also a bit more complicated sometimes.
Do you prefer using new or old technology?
I prefer new technology because it is faster and has better features. Old devices are often slow and lack modern functions that I find essential for my daily routine, such as smart assistants.
Is it important to have the latest gadgets?

Not really, I don't think so. Many people buy new things just to show off, which is a waste of money. I believe that as long as the device works well and meets your needs, there is no need to spend too much on the newest model.
Do you enjoy giving gifts to others?
Yes, I do. I think giving presents is a nice way to show affection and strengthen relationships with friends and family. It makes me feel happy when I see their faces light up when they open the box.
What kind of gifts do you usually buy?

It depends on who the gift is for. For my friends, I often choose personalized items like mugs or notebooks with their names on them. For older relatives, I prefer practical things like health supplements or high-quality tea, because I think those are more useful.
Is it difficult to choose a gift for people you do not know well?

Yes, it can be quite challenging. I sometimes struggle to find something appropriate that is not too personal but still thoughtful. I often end up buying generic items like chocolates or flowers because they are safe choices that rarely offend anyone.
Do you think expensive gifts are always better?

No, I don't agree with that. The value of a gift does not necessarily come from its price tag. A small, handmade gift that shows effort and care is often more meaningful than an expensive item bought without much thought.
What time do you usually get up?
I normally get up at six in the morning because I have to go to work early.
What do you do after you get up?
First I wash my face, then I have a quick breakfast of rice and tea before I catch the bus.
How do you spend your evenings?
In the evening I usually finish my tasks, then I relax by watching a drama or reading a book before I go to bed around ten.
Do you have any regular exercise?
Yes, I try to jog for thirty minutes in the park three times a week, although sometimes the weather makes it difficult.
How would you describe the environment in your hometown?
My hometown is near a river, so there are many trees and a lot of fresh air, but lately the traffic is getting worse.
What are some of the main environmental problems there?
The biggest problem is the air pollution from factories, and also the waste that people throw in the streets, which makes the river dirty.
What do people do to improve the situation?
The local government has started a recycling program and they also plant more trees, but many residents still ignore the rules.
Do you think the situation will get better?
I hope so, because younger people are more aware about climate, however it will take time and cooperation from everyone.
Do you enjoy reading books?
Yes, I really do, because it helps me to relax after a long day at work, but I usually only read novels that have a strong plot, so I don't spend too much time on poetry.
What kind of books do you prefer to read?
I am mostly interested in mystery stories, as they keep me curious about what will happen next, although sometimes I find the endings a bit disappointing if they are not logical enough.
How often do you read?
Probably three times a week, which is not very frequent, but I try to read for at least twenty minutes before I go to sleep to clear my mind from daily stressors.
Do you prefer reading physical books or electronic ones?

I prefer physical books, because I enjoy the smell of paper and the feel of the pages, whereas e-readers are more convenient for traveling since they are lightweight and can store many novels at once.
Do you like cooking?
I am quite fond of it, since preparing meals allows me to be creative, but I do not do it very often because I am usually too tired after work to stand in the kitchen for a long time.
What is your favorite dish to cook?
It has to be chicken soup, as it is very comforting during cold weather, and the process of simmering the broth is quite meditative, even though it takes a lot of patience to get the flavor right.
Do you prefer sweet or savory food?
I generally lean towards savory tastes, because I find them more satisfying for lunch, but I do enjoy a small piece of chocolate after dinner to balance out the saltiness of the main course.
How do you usually eat your meals?

I mostly eat with my family, which makes the time more social and pleasant, although on weekends I might eat alone while watching a movie if I am trying to finish a show I have been following for weeks.
Do you often use technology in your free time?
Yes, I usually use my smartphone to watch videos and sometimes play games when I have some spare time.
What kind of activities do you prefer online?
I like browsing social media, especially to see updates from friends, and also I enjoy listening to music streaming services.
Has this changed the way you relax?
Definitely, before I used to read books more, but now I find digital content more convenient and quicker to access.
Do you think technology will replace traditional hobbies?
I think it might influence them, but I believe some people will still prefer hands‑on activities like painting or gardening because they give a different feeling.
How do you choose a gift for someone?
I usually think about what the person likes and then try to find something related, for example if they enjoy cooking I might buy a nice kitchen tool.
Do you ever buy gifts online?
Yes, I often use online shops because they have many options and sometimes cheaper prices than physical stores.
What was the most memorable gift you gave?
The most memorable was a handmade photo album for my sister's birthday, because I spent a lot of time arranging the pictures and she was really touched.
Do you think the price matters most?
I think the thought behind the gift is more important than the cost, although a reasonable price can make it easier to give without worrying about budget.
What time do you usually get up?
I generally rise around six-thirty in the morning, because I like to have a quiet hour before the city awakens.
What do you do after you get up?
After washing up, I prepare a modest breakfast—usually some rice porridge with a boiled egg—and then I head out to catch the bus to work.
How do you commute to your workplace?
I take the municipal bus, which departs from a stop two blocks from my apartment; the ride lasts about twenty minutes, and I often read the news on my phone during that time.
What is the most enjoyable part of your daily routine?
I find the short walk to the office the most pleasant, as the streets are lined with blossoming trees and the air feels fresh after the early morning drizzle.
How would you describe the environment in your neighbourhood?
My neighbourhood is a blend of old wooden houses and newly built apartments, interspersed with small parks where elders gather for morning exercises.
What kind of green spaces are available nearby?
There is a modest community garden beside the elementary school, featuring a variety of herbs, ornamental shrubs, and a few fruit trees that residents tend to collectively.
Do you think the local environment has changed over the years?
Definitely; over the past decade, several traditional stalls have been replaced by modern cafés, and the once‑narrow lanes have been widened to accommodate increasing traffic.
How does the environment affect your daily life?
The proximity to green areas encourages me to jog in the mornings, while the bustling streets provide convenient access to shops, so I rarely need to travel far for daily necessities.
Do you enjoy reading books?
Yes, I absolutely love reading; it transports me to different worlds and broadens my perspective.
What kind of books do you prefer?
I tend to favour historical novels because they blend factual detail with compelling narratives, which I find both enlightening and entertaining.
How often do you read?
I try to read at least an hour each evening, usually before bedtime, and on weekends I might spend a few extra hours immersed in a longer work.
Do you think reading habits are changing nowadays?
Indeed, with the rise of digital platforms, many people now skim articles on tablets rather than delving into printed books, which alters the depth of comprehension.
What kind of food do you like the most?
I have a particular fondness for Vietnamese street food, especially phở, because its fragrant broth and fresh herbs create a harmonious balance of flavors.
How often do you eat out?
I usually dine out two or three times a week, mainly for lunch, as it allows me to sample diverse cuisines without the hassle of cooking.
Do you enjoy cooking at home?
Yes, I relish the opportunity to experiment with ingredients, and I often prepare traditional dishes like bánh cuốn, which requires meticulous technique.
Has your taste in food changed over the years?
Certainly, when I was younger I preferred milder flavours, but as I matured I started appreciating spicier and more complex dishes, such as those featuring fermented shrimp paste.
What influences your food choices?
My selections are largely guided by health considerations, cultural heritage, and occasional recommendations from friends who introduce me to novel eateries.
Do you often use technology in your leisure time?
Yes, I usually spend my free evenings scrolling through curated video platforms or experimenting with photo‑editing apps, which I find quite relaxing after a long day.
What kind of activities do you prefer online?
I tend to gravitate towards interactive documentaries and language‑learning games because they combine entertainment with personal development.
Has your use of technology changed over the years?

Definitely; when I was younger I mostly played simple mobile games, but now I use sophisticated streaming services and even virtual‑reality tours to explore distant cultures without leaving my apartment.
Do you think technology improves your leisure experience?
I believe it does, as it provides instant access to a vast array of content, allowing me to customise my downtime according to my mood and interests.
How do you usually choose a gift for someone?
I start by considering the person’s hobbies and recent remarks, then I look for something that aligns with those interests but also has a touch of novelty.
Can you give an example of a recent gift you gave?
Last month I bought a handcrafted leather journal for my colleague who loves sketching, because I knew she appreciated artisanal items and could use it for her designs.
Do you prefer giving practical or sentimental gifts?
I tend to blend both; a practical item that also carries emotional weight, like a personalized mug with a meaningful quote, feels more thoughtful than a purely utilitarian present.
How important is the packaging of a gift?
Packaging matters a lot; an elegantly wrapped parcel creates anticipation and shows that I invested effort, which often enhances the recipient’s appreciation.
Do you ever buy gifts online?
Yes, especially when the item is niche or custom‑made; online platforms allow me to compare options and read reviews, ensuring the gift meets my standards before I commit.
What time do you usually get up?
I normally get up around six o’clock, because I like to have a quiet hour before work.
What do you do after getting up?
First I drink a glass of water, then I do a short stretch routine and prepare breakfast, usually some rice porridge with fruit.
How do you travel to work?
I take the city bus, which takes about thirty minutes, although sometimes I ride my bicycle when the weather is nice.
What do you usually do in the evening?
In the evening I finish any remaining tasks, then I have dinner with my family and we often watch a TV series before going to bed.
How would you describe the environment in your neighbourhood?
My neighbourhood is quite green, with many trees lining the streets and a small park where children play.
Are there any problems with the local environment?
One issue is the traffic noise during rush hour, and sometimes the air feels a bit hazy because of nearby construction.
What do you think could be done to improve it?
The local council could increase the number of bike lanes and plant more shrubs to filter dust, which would make the area quieter and healthier.
Do you feel the community is involved in environmental issues?
Yes, many residents join clean‑up groups on weekends and there’s a community garden that encourages sustainable practices.
Do you like reading books in your free time?

Absolutely. I actually find that I read more often during the week than I do on weekends because I usually have more structured time to sit down with a novel. On weekends, I tend to get distracted by social plans or just relaxing on the sofa without a specific purpose.
What kind of books do you usually read?

I’m quite fond of literary fiction and biographies. I recently finished a biography of a famous architect, which was fascinating because it provided a behind-the-scenes look at how he approached complex design problems. It wasn’t just dry facts; it was very personal.
Do you prefer e-books or paper books?

I definitely have a preference for physical books. There is something tactile about turning pages that I miss with an e-reader. However, I will use an e-book if I am travelling, as it is much lighter and I don’t have to worry about carrying multiple volumes.
How often do you buy new books?

Not very frequently. I usually try to exhaust my current supply from the library first. I only purchase a book when I find a specific title that is out of print or if I am particularly eager to start a new series immediately without waiting for a library slot.
Do you enjoy cooking at home?

Yes, I do. It’s a very therapeutic activity for me. After a long day at work, the process of chopping vegetables and mixing ingredients helps me decompress. I find that the result is always more hygienic and tailored to my taste compared to ordering out.
What types of food do you like to prepare?

I mostly stick to Vietnamese cuisine, such as pho or spring rolls, because I want to replicate the authentic flavours from my grandmother’s recipes. Occasionally, I experiment with Italian pasta, but I haven’t quite mastered the technique for making fresh dough yet.
Is it easy for you to cook?

It has become much easier over time. When I started, I often burnt things or got the seasoning wrong. Now, I have developed a better sense of timing and heat control. I still refer to online recipes for new dishes, but for my staples, I cook almost entirely from memory.
Do you think people in your country eat healthier food now?

It’s a mixed bag. On one hand, there is a growing awareness about nutrition, and many people are opting for organic produce and less processed food. On the other hand, the convenience of fast food remains a significant issue, especially among younger generations who lead busy lives and often lack the time to prepare a full meal from scratch.
Do you often use technology in your free time?
Yes, I usually spend my leisure time on my tablet, reading news articles or watching short videos because it helps me relax after a busy day.
What kind of activities do you prefer online?
I tend to prefer educational content, such as language learning apps, but I also enjoy streaming documentaries and occasionally playing casual puzzle games to unwind.
Has your use of technology changed over the years?
Definitely. When I was younger I mostly used a desktop computer for schoolwork, but now I rely on my smartphone and smartwatch for almost everything, from music to fitness tracking.
Do you think technology improves your leisure experiences?
I believe it does, because it gives me instant access to a wide range of entertainment and information, which makes my free time more varied and engaging.
How do you choose a gift for someone?
I start by thinking about the person’s hobbies and recent interests, then I try to find something that matches those, like a cooking class voucher for a friend who loves recipes.
Do you ever buy gifts online?
Yes, I often browse online shops because they offer many options and reviews, which helps me decide if the item is suitable and of good quality.
What was the most memorable gift you have given?
The most memorable was a handcrafted wooden photo frame I ordered for my sister’s birthday; she was thrilled because it displayed a family picture and reflected her love for natural materials.
Do you think the price of a gift matters?
I think the thought behind the gift matters more than its cost; a modest but thoughtful present can be more appreciated than an expensive, impersonal one.
What time do you usually get up?
I normally get up around six thirty in the morning.
How do you spend your mornings?
First I drink a cup of coffee, then I read the news and prepare for work.
Do you prefer a routine or a flexible schedule?
I prefer a routine because it helps me stay organised and reduces stress.
What do you do after work?
After work I usually go to the gym, then I cook dinner and relax with a book.
How often do you exercise?
I try to exercise at least four times a week, mostly in the evenings.
How would you describe the environment in your hometown?
My hometown is surrounded by hills and a river, so it feels quite green and fresh.
What are the main environmental challenges there?
The biggest challenge is traffic congestion, which leads to air pollution during rush hour.
Are there any initiatives to improve the environment?
Yes, the local council has introduced bike lanes and planted more trees along main streets.
Do you think residents are supportive of these changes?
Most people are supportive because they see the benefits for health and quality of life.
How does the climate affect daily life?
The tropical climate means it’s hot and humid most of the year, so people often schedule outdoor activities in the early morning.
Do you enjoy reading books?
Yes, I really enjoy reading books, especially novels and biographies.
What kind of books do you read most often?
I tend to read contemporary fiction because the stories feel relevant to everyday life, but I also pick up a few history books when I have spare time.
How often do you read?
I try to read at least one chapter every evening before I go to sleep, so that’s roughly five to six days a week.
Do you prefer reading printed books or e‑books?
I prefer printed books; I like the feeling of turning the pages and the smell of paper, although e‑books are convenient for travelling.
What type of food do you like the most?
I love Vietnamese cuisine the most, especially dishes like phở and bánh mì because they combine fresh herbs, subtle spices and a balanced broth.
Do you often cook at home?
Yes, I cook at home several times a week; I enjoy experimenting with different sauces and fresh vegetables.
What is a typical meal in your family?
A typical dinner includes steamed rice, a stir‑fried vegetable dish, and a protein such as grilled fish or tofu, followed by a small bowl of soup.
Is there any foreign cuisine you like?
I’m quite fond of Japanese food, especially sushi and ramen, because the flavors are clean and the presentation is elegant.
Do you think your eating habits will change in the future?
I think I’ll try to incorporate more plant‑based meals as I become more health‑conscious, but I’ll still keep my favourite traditional dishes.
Do you often use technology for leisure?
Yes, I usually watch movies or play games on my tablet in the evenings.
What kind of games do you prefer?
I like puzzle games because they are challenging but not too stressful.
Do you think technology has changed the way people relax?
Definitely, people now can stream music or read e‑books anywhere, which was impossible a few decades ago.
Do you ever take a break from screens?
I try to go for a walk or meet friends face‑to‑face at least once a week.
How do you choose a gift for someone?
I think about the person’s hobbies and try to find something useful that matches their interests.
Can you give an example of a recent gift you gave?
Last month I gave my sister a high‑quality sketchbook because she loves drawing.
Do you prefer giving practical or sentimental gifts?
I usually blend both; a practical item that also has a personal touch feels most meaningful.
How important is the presentation of a gift?
Very important – a nicely wrapped gift shows effort and makes the moment more special.
Do you ever buy gifts online?
Yes, I often order online because it offers more variety and I can compare prices easily.
